title: AIAS End-to-End Project Production
purpose: Demonstrate the complete governed AIAS project chain from planning through operating custody on Lighthouse.
scope: PMO plan, virtual assignment, technical file, independent review, AEOS, CNS, signed recovery, cloud-neutral custody, release and professional boundary.

requirements.title: Complete chain
requirements.statement: Production shall connect planning, assignment, generation, review, release, handover, operation, recovery and custody.
requirements.rationale: Prove system integration across the digital company.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Independent review
requirements.statement: Author and virtual reviewer shall be different identities and regulated authority shall remain human.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Operating evidence
requirements.statement: Lighthouse shall reach AEOS OPERATING with seven durable CNS lifecycle events.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Resilience and custody
requirements.statement: The final technical release shall pass a signed recovery drill and tenant-isolated cloud-neutral custody.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Honest status
requirements.statement: The output shall remain reference-for-review and shall not claim professional approval or audited organizational Level 5.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: End-to-end production shall include tests, documentation, installer, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
